HEADS UP, MOTORISTS!

The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority announced on Sunday that it will no longer proceed with the planned odd-even traffic scheme following President Bongbong Marcos' order to suspend the rehabilitation of EDSA.

Read: https://t.co/8iPVc9tEWZ https://t.co/w2a1PAWb9e

data.raw_text: The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority has canceled the implementation of the odd-even scheme following the order of President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.’s to reset for another month the EDSA rebuild, which was supposed to start June 13. The existing number coding scheme stays.
